module: Flowgraph node 'Stop Auto Replay'. Stops the current recording if there is one (missionReplay module). If 'attemptNotCompleted' is true (mission attempt not completed), first saves the meta information without attempt.
notes: work runs every frame, without testing the input impulse 'stopRec'.
